messages:
elaine: Quick follow-up: two PRs diverged on rollout metadata shape (compact ref vs verbose JSON). We need a migration story before finalizing.

peter: Examples help.

elaine: Compact: `{"anchor_ref":"h:9c3f","flags":2}`. Verbose: `{"source":"registry/v3","cohort":"canary-12","fallbacks":["small-v2"],"expires":"2026-08-01T00:00:00Z","provenance":[{"commit":"b7a1","by":"jia"}]}`

jia: My preference: keep canonical verbose in CP for audits, emit compact ref in hot-path. Two key fields: "anchor_hash" (content-hash) and optional "anchor_snapshot" (tiny routing hint).

peter: Important ops constraints: Dedicated/private runtimes cannot block on CP. Runtime must include LRU cache + snapshot fallback. On cache miss, try CP with tight timeout (e.g., 30ms), else use snapshot.

elaine: Migration: additive fields only. Add "anchor_hash" (string) and "anchor_snapshot" (object optional) to envelope. Older components ignore them. Canonical records immutable; updates create new anchor_hash with "prev_anchor" link.

jia: Retention: lifecycle tiers in canonical JSON: transient(30d), standard(180d), permanent(10y). CP GC with export before deletion. Snapshot size budget <=256 bytes.

infra-bot: Reminder: schema changes require migration plan and rollback playbook. See /playbooks/schema-change-template.

elaine: Action items: I'll draft appendix with exact field names and staged rollout under feature flag; peter to spec runtime caching and fallback tests; jia to own retention/export. Will PR tomorrow if no objections.
